headline: OpenAI reports model-generated improvements to production AMD chip designs and higher scores on RISC-V design tasks
summary: In a 18 November research release, OpenAI says models helped redesign blocks in its Jalapeño inference chip and contributed RTL changes to AMD GPU and CPU designs, reporting up to 14% PPA improvement on a flagship GPU IP baseline and single-digit gains on selected CPU blocks. It also reports 9,881 RISC-V evaluation runs in which GPT-6.2 Astra led at comparable token budgets. The manufacturing and performance figures are first-party claims; the controlled evaluation covers two cores and omits physical-synthesis timing.
